analysis:
Examined both test files, supplied BASE/HEAD text, resume-test patch and file metadata against the indexed threat model. scripts/test-provider-release-resolution.py HEAD 107–121 adds expectations that dispatches on dev publish dev-branch builds, ignore validation/version overrides, and reject other environments without outputs. scripts/test-provider-release-resume.py HEAD 164–174 (patch) adds current-dev-HEAD admission and stale-commit/non-dev-environment rejection; HEAD 49, 54–55 extend the API fixture. Existing production-tag, master-source, recovery-artifact, qualification-job and no-output-on-failure tests remain intact in the supplied scope. No concrete vulnerability is established by these test-only changes; they do not themselves expose credentials or alter serving, encryption, cache, billing or privileged controls.
Integration must verify that resolve-provider-release.sh and provider_release_resume/api.py implement these expectations consistently and that release workflow callers gate signing/publication before credentials are available. In particular, confirm dev dispatch cannot select production credentials or bypass independent build qualification (A-005, A-011, A-017, T-054), and reconcile publish=true despite validation-only input with the caller's intended contract. Those implementations/callers are not supplied here, so the tests are expectations, not proof of enforcement or a regression. No tests were executed.
